'''Gelagrubs''', also known as '''Felucian ground beetles''', were large [[Insect/Legends|insectine]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==Characteristics==
The gelatinous larva-like<ref name=":0">{{DB|creature|feluciagroundbeetle|Felucia ground beetle}}</ref> gelagrub was about the size of a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] and has evolved in the dangerous climate of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], giving it numerous natural defenses against the planet's hazards.<ref name=":1">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Their preferred habitat was among the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] towering [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. The gelagrub had a wide [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] above which were two vertically aligned [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and two rows of stubby [[Limb/Legends|legs]] endowed with adhesive characteristics that enabled it to climb steep inclines. The gelagrub had to eat constantly to maintain its natural sunscreen, while it absorbed food throughout their waking hours as they moved across [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and required no actual feeding or watering while on patrol.<ref name=":1" />

[[File:Gelagrub-ROTS.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] riding a gelagrub on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].]]
They were easily domesticated creatures whose [[Larva/Legends|larval]] forms were used as mounts by [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] colonists, while they were occasionally transplanted to other jungle worlds.<ref name=":1" /> Like the rest of Felucia's flora and fauna, the gelagrub had its own unique adaptations to the intense ultraviolet rays of the planet's sun. The gelatinous larval form was, for example, one of many Felucian creatures with a shimmering, semi-transparent skin. It was able to metabolize UV-filtering chemicals from its lichen food source, and distribute them to hypodermic ducts, affording the gelagrub's internal organs a natural sunscreen. This also meant these creatures were constantly eating.

When a gelagrub pupated, the adult emerged as a hard-shelled ground creature, not unlike a giant beetle, with a mirrored carapace in the place of the larval translucent skin to reflect the worst of the sun's rays.

Gelagrubs were favored mounts on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and similar worlds because of their ability to protect their riders. Once a rider had sufficiently bonded with a domesticated gelagrub, it treated the rider as an extension of its own body, going out of its way to avoid hazards and using its own natural defenses to protect its rider.<ref name=":1" />

==History==
[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], in particular those part of [[Felucia Star Corps]] assigned to [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], employed gelagrubs as mounts during the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] sold a [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically modified]] gelagrub that was designed to not pupate into their beetle form. They were used as mounts by Imperial troops. The company also offered freeze-dried packets of specially formulated food for their gelagrubs, in the event that the world they were dispatched to lacked any fungi such as mushrooms or similar fungus. Unlike other mounted creatures sold by Rothana, this did not have a specific price listed. Instead, they were available via special order only, and required a representative for the pricing.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ground beetle was developed by ILM digital artist Paul Giacoppo as an entirely digital creature. Designed to fit into the Felucia environment, it had a translucent "gummy" like sheen.<ref name=":0" />
